# ForgeSuite Studio — Full Portfolio Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Complete machine-readable documentation for ForgeSuite Studio by `youthmy11-ai` (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/`): 11 catalog offerings (8 live client-side web apps including TokenGuard EVM & Solana Risk Scanner and BrandGuard 8-TLD Domain & Handle Checker, 2 open-core packaged GitHub tools, 1 zero-dependency Node 20+ MCP Server v1.2.0 with 7 tools executable via `npx --yes github:youthmy11-ai/youthmy11-ai.github.io`, and 1 All-Access Lifetime Bundle), transparent one-time pricing ($0 free tiers, $15–$49 lifetime Pro pricing), strict client-side privacy guarantees, and zero-backend crypto + PayPal checkout.

---

## 1. Architecture & Client-Side Privacy Guarantees

ForgeSuite Studio is engineered as a **zero-backend, local-first software suite** hosted on static GitHub Pages (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/`) and open-source GitHub repositories (`https://github.com/youthmy11-ai`):

1. **Zero Data Uploads & Zero Telemetry**: All 7 web tools execute purely inside local browser memory (`HTML5 + ES Modules`). No prompts, invoices, API payloads, contracts, EVM calldata, or `.env` secrets are ever transmitted to any ForgeSuite server. TokenGuard queries CORS-friendly public JSON-RPC nodes (`PublicNode`, `Zan`) directly from the user's browser.
2. **Offline Pure-JS QR Generation (`assets/qr.js`)**: Every payment QR code across the storefront and CryptoBill Forge is generated deterministically in-browser using a custom ISO/IEC 18004 Version 1–10 pure JavaScript encoder with zero external QR image APIs.
3. **Serverless URL-Fragment Sharing (`#inv=`)**: CryptoBill Forge encodes shareable client invoices directly into UTF-8 Base64URL hash fragments (`#inv=...`) so clients can inspect read-only A4 invoices and scan payment QR codes without any database.
4. **Deterministic Offline License Keys (`FS-PRO-...`)**: Pro licenses use a shared 4-hex-digit FNV-1a 32-bit folded checksum (`^FS-PRO-(CB|AS|WL|BUNDLE)-[A-Z0-9]{8}-[0-9A-F]{4}$`) verified 100% offline across the web storefront, TokenGuard Pro Watchlist, AutoShorts Studio (Python), and WebLead Extractor (Chrome MV3).

## 3. Detailed Tool Specifications

### 3.1 CryptoBill Forge (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/cryptobill.html`)
- **Category**: BusinessApplication (Web)
- **Pricing**: Free Tier ($0) + Pro Lifetime License ($15, SKU `CB`)
- **Capabilities**:
  - A4 print-ready invoice layout (`@media print` to PDF) with live editor preview and automatic `localStorage` draft saving.
  - Supports USD, EUR, and USDT currency formatting, line-item quantity/price math, percentage discounts, and tax calculation.
  - Multi-rail freelancer receiving config: Solana SPL USDC, USDT (BEP20/BSC), USDT (TRC20/TRON), PayPal Direct URL, and Binance Pay ID with offline SVG/PNG QR generation.
  - Read-only Client Payment View via serverless `#inv=<base64url>` shareable URLs.
  - JSON export/import backup of single invoices or bulk templates.
  - **Pro Unlocks ($15 Lifetime)**: Unlimited line items (Free caps at 3), unlimited saved templates (Free caps at 2), white-label PDF (remove footer badge), custom brand accent color & monogram, and bulk batch JSON template presets.

### 3.2 AutoShorts Studio (`https://github.com/youthmy11-ai/autoshorts-studio`)
- **Category**: MultimediaApplication (Windows, macOS, Linux — Python 3.10+ & FFmpeg)
- **Pricing**: MIT Community Edition ($0) + Pro Lifetime License ($19, SKU `AS`)
- **Capabilities**:
  - Content-addressed **SQLite WAL SHA-256 deduplication** ensures source media clips are never recycled across batch runs.
  - **Beat-milestone audio slicer** (`MM:SS`, `HH:MM:SS`, seconds, or cumulative durations) with fade-in/fade-out envelopes and montage synchronization.
  - **Beat-synced SubRip (`.srt`) subtitle generator** (`python -m autoshorts_studio.cli subtitles-srt`) aligning caption lines directly to beat timestamps.
  - **Multi-aspect FFmpeg render pipeline**: `9:16` (`1080x1920` blurred ambient pillarbox or smart crop), `16:9` (`1920x1080`), `1:1` (`1080x1080`), smooth Ken Burns motion for static images, and optional EBU R128 (`-14 LUFS`) loudness normalization.
  - **Pro Unlocks ($19 Lifetime)**: Simultaneous multi-preset rendering, custom brand watermark overlay hook, and batch queue limit raised from 5 to 500 outputs/run.

### 3.3 WebLead & Table Extractor (`https://github.com/youthmy11-ai/weblead-extractor`)
- **Category**: BrowserApplication (Chrome, Edge, Brave Manifest V3 Extension)
- **Pricing**: MIT Lite Edition ($0) + Pro Lifetime License ($15, SKU `WL`)
- **Capabilities**:
  - Minimal permissions (`activeTab` + on-demand `scripting` only when clicked); zero remote servers, zero persistent background scripts, zero DOM mutation.
  - Extracts standard HTML `<table>` elements (expanding `colspan` and `rowspan` cleanly), modern ARIA `[role="table"]` / `[role="grid"]` widgets, and embedded `<script type="application/ld+json">` Schema.org entities (`Organization`, `LocalBusiness`, `@graph`).
  - Exports strict RFC-4180 CSV, JSON, and GitHub-Flavored Markdown (`Copy MD`).
  - **Pro Unlocks ($15 Lifetime)**: Unlimited exported rows per table (Lite caps at 25 rows), live regex row filtering, and offline key activation (`FS-PRO-WL-...` / `FS-PRO-BUNDLE-...`).

### 3.4 All-Access Creator & Freelancer Bundle (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/#pricing`)
- **Pricing**: **$35 Lifetime** (Compare at $49 individual total — Save $14, SKU `BUNDLE`).
- **Scope**: Issues one universal `FS-PRO-BUNDLE-...` key that instantly unlocks CryptoBill Forge Pro and TokenGuard 25-Token Batch Watchlist in-browser, and activates both AutoShorts Studio Pro and WebLead & Table Extractor Pro offline, including v1.x updates and priority email support.

### 3.5 TokenCost Lab (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/tokencalc.html`)
- **Category**: DeveloperApplication (Web — 100% Free)
- **Capabilities**:
  - Local prompt token estimator (tokens, words, chars, UTF-8 bytes, lines) for English prose, source code, JSON, and Unicode/CJK/Vietnamese text.
  - Compares per-request and monthly AI agent API costs across frontier models (GPT-5, Claude 4.5, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek V3) with configurable prompt-cache hit ratios, daily request volume, and agency margin multipliers.
  - 1-click export of client quotes directly into CryptoBill Forge (`cryptobill.html#inv=...`).

### 3.6 JSON2Sheet & PII Masker (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/json2sheet.html`)
- **Category**: DeveloperApplication (Web — 100% Free)
- **Capabilities**:
  - Automatically unwraps API list containers (`data`, `items`, etc.) and flattens deeply nested JSON objects/arrays via dot notation.
  - Exports Excel-safe RFC-4180 CSV, Google Sheets-ready TSV, or GitHub Markdown tables with CSV Formula Injection Guard (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`) and 1-click PII & Secret Masking.

### 3.7 ScopeGuard SOW Builder (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/sowbuilder.html`)
- **Category**: BusinessApplication (Web — 100% Free)
- **Capabilities**:
  - Built-in project presets for AI Workflow MVPs, Web3 Smart Contract Audits, and Chrome Extension builds with 100%-balanced milestone percentage splits and 1-click CryptoBill Forge (`#inv=`) export.

### 3.8 Calldata Lens (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/txdecode.html`)
- **Category**: DeveloperApplication (Web — 100% Free)
- **Capabilities**:
  - Decodes raw `0x` Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain hex calldata offline with zero RPC tracking, highlighting unlimited `MAX_UINT256` token approvals and formatting 18-decimal / 6-decimal token units.

### 3.9 EnvShield Secret Scanner (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/envshield.html`)
- **Category**: SecurityApplication (Web — 100% Free)
- **Capabilities**:
  - Scans `.env` files, JSON configs, shell logs, Git diffs, and AI chat transcripts strictly inside browser memory using 13 deterministic secret detectors + Shannon entropy analysis, outputting safely redacted text (`<REDACTED:...>`).

### 3.10 TokenGuard — EVM & Solana Token/Contract Risk Scanner (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/tokenaudit.html`)
- **Category**: SecurityApplication (Web — Free Single Scans + Pro Batch Watchlist in $35 Bundle)
- **Reusable Engine**: `https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/assets/tokenaudit.js` (Pure ES Module compatible with Browser & Node.js 22+)
- **Capabilities**:
  - **PUSH-Aware EVM Bytecode Disassembler**: Strips trailing Solidity CBOR metadata and skips `PUSH1..PUSH32` immediate operands so embedded bytes are never misclassified as `SELFDESTRUCT` (`0xff`), `DELEGATECALL` (`0xf4`), `CALLCODE` (`0xf2`), or `ORIGIN` (`0x32`).
  - **Proxy & Implementation Inspection**: Reads EIP-1967 (`implementation`, `admin`, `beacon`), OpenZeppelin/FiatToken (`zeppelinos`), and EIP-1167 minimal clone slots across **Base**, **Ethereum**, **BSC**, and **Arbitrum** via CORS-safe PublicNode primaries (`base-rpc.publicnode.com`, `ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com`, `bsc-rpc.publicnode.com`, `arbitrum-one-rpc.publicnode.com`), then disassembles the underlying implementation bytecode for `mint`, `blacklist`, `pause`, and mutable honeypot `tax` / `maxTx` selectors.
  - **Solana SPL & Token-2022 Mint Rug Audit**: Queries CORS-safe Solana Mainnet RPCs (`solana-rpc.publicnode.com`, `api.zan.top/solana-mainnet`) to inspect active `mintAuthority`, `freezeAuthority`, dangerous Token-2022 extensions (`permanentDelegate`, `transferFeeConfig`, `mintCloseAuthority`, `transferHook`, `defaultAccountState`, `nonTransferable`), supply, and Top-10 holder concentration.
  - **Pro Watchlist & Deep Source Audit Funnel**: Unlocks multi-chain **Batch Watchlist Multi-Token Audit (`<= 25` addresses at once + JSON/CSV Risk Dossier export)** with any ForgeSuite Pro / All-Access Bundle (`$35` lifetime), and links directly to **Forge AI Agent** (`$5.00 USDC` via A2A + x402 at `https://market.near.ai/a/forge-ai-agent`) for line-by-line Solidity/Rust source audits.

### 3.11 ForgeSuite MCP Server v1.2.0 (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/mcp.html`)
- **Category**: DeveloperApplication (Windows, macOS, Linux — Node.js 20+, 0 npm dependencies, MIT Free)
- **1-Command Global Install**: `npx --yes github:youthmy11-ai/youthmy11-ai.github.io`
- **Direct Single-File URL**: `https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/mcp/forgesuite-mcp.mjs`
- **Capabilities**:
  - Single-file zero-dependency JSON-RPC 2.0 Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server (`v1.2.0`) compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, and Windsurf.
  - Exposes **7 tools**:
    1. `envshield_scan` — offline secret leak detection & redaction
    2. `calldata_decode` — offline EVM ABI decoding + `MaxUint256` unlimited approval warnings
    3. `tokencost_estimate` — multi-turn LLM cost & retainer estimation across Claude/GPT-5/Gemini/DeepSeek
    4. `cryptobill_quote` — Markdown/JSON crypto invoice + live serverless `cryptobill.html#inv=` URL
    5. `evm_token_risk_scan` — live EVM token/proxy/opcode risk audit across Base/Ethereum/BSC/Arbitrum
    6. `solana_mint_risk_scan` — live Solana SPL / Token-2022 authority, extension & holder concentration risk audit
    7. `brand_domain_handle_scan` — live authoritative RDAP + Google DoH domain (`.com`, `.io`, `.ai`, `.dev`, `.app`, `.org`), developer registry (`npm`, `PyPI`, `GitHub`), social (`Bluesky`, `Reddit`), and Apple iOS App Store availability scanner

### 3.12 BrandGuard — 8-TLD Domain, Developer Registry & App Store Scanner (`https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/brandcheck.html`)
- **Category**: BusinessApplication (Web — Free Single + 4 Variations + Pro 25-Brand Agency Matrix in `$15` Pro / `$35` Bundle)
- **Reusable Engine**: `https://youthmy11-ai.github.io/assets/brandcheck.js` (Pure ES Module compatible with Browser & Node.js 20+)
- **Capabilities**:
  - **100% CORS-Clean 8-TLD Domain Verification**: Queries Google DNS-over-HTTPS (`NS` + `A` records at `dns.google/resolve`) and CORS-enabled authoritative RDAP endpoints across `.com`, `.io`, `.ai`, `.dev`, `.app`, `.org`, `.net`, and `.xyz` (with automatic clean fallback to DoH if `rdap.org` redirects to a non-CORS registry), distinguishing `Likely Available (NXDOMAIN)` from `Registered (Active DNS/RDAP)`.
  - **5 Developer, Social & App Store Registries**: Live browser checks across `npm` (`registry.npmjs.org`), `PyPI` (`pypi.org/pypi/<name>/json`), `GitHub` (`api.github.com/users/<name>`), `Bluesky` (`public.api.bsky.app` ATProto handle resolution), and the US **Apple iOS App Store** (`itunes.apple.com/search`).
  - **Readiness Scoring, Variations & Agency Matrix**: Computes a deterministic `0–100` Brand Launch Readiness Score with UTC timestamps, generates 6 Smart Name Variations (`get`, `use`, `hq`, `labs`, `ai`, `try` — 4 parallel checks free, all 6 + `<= 25` Batch Agency Matrix + CSV/JSON exports in Pro), provides 1-click **ScopeGuard SOW** (`sowbuilder.html#sow=...`) and **CryptoBill** (`cryptobill.html#inv=...`) handoffs, and links directly to our `$0.35 USDC` autonomous agent **Brand Name Availability Checker** (`https://market.near.ai/agents/forge-brand-checker`) for official USPTO Registration/Serial Number trademark screening + Google Play + Reddit/YouTube/Telegram/TikTok/Instagram/X verification.
